channel.title: Warhammer Community RSS Feed
channel.description: Latest intelligence reports from the Warhammer Community

item.title: This year’s Warhammer event miniatures revealed
item.description: The Warhammer article reveals this year's event-exclusive miniatures, showcasing new and highly detailed models that are available at specific Warhammer events throughout the year.

item.title: Sunday Preview – The galaxy calls, and Krieg answers
item.description: This Sunday Preview announces the release of new Warhammer 40,000 Death Korps of Krieg miniatures and related gaming content, showcasing the regiment's iconic grim resolve and distinctive battlefield equipment.

item.title: Astartes II – Official Teaser Trailer | Warhammer+
item.description: The official teaser trailer for "Astartes II" on Warhammer+ showcases intense, visually striking scenes of Space Marine action, hinting at the continuation of the acclaimed fan-made project now officially embraced by the Warhammer universe.

item.title: Astartes II Teaser Trailer – Watch it right now
item.description: The Astartes II teaser trailer, now available for viewing, promises intense action and deeper exploration into the Warhammer 40,000 universe, showcasing the formidable Space Marines in a new chapter of their saga.

item.title: Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors painted by the wider Warhammer Hobby Community
item.description: The article showcases a collection of Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors expertly painted by members of the Warhammer hobby community, highlighting their creative talents and the vibrant diversity of painting styles within the community.

item.title: Warhammer Studio Interview – Designing the new Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors
item.description: The article features a Warhammer Studio interview that explores the creative process and design considerations involved in updating the Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors for the Warhammer 40,000 game.

item.title: New Phoenix Lords with Contrast! | Warhammer 40,000
item.description: The article introduces new Phoenix Lords models for Warhammer 40,000, showcasing their enhanced details and vibrant coloring achieved through the Contrast painting method.

item.title: Aeldari Corsair showcase: The Ballad of the Sky Serpents
item.description: The article "Aeldari Corsair Showcase: The Ballad of the Sky Serpents" on the Warhammer Community website features a detailed look at a beautifully painted Aeldari Corsair army, highlighting their unique aesthetics and backstory.

item.title: Who are the Phoenix Lords? The legendary Aeldari heroes explained
item.description: The Phoenix Lords are revered, ancient Aeldari warriors who embody the martial aspects of their god, serving as both immortal heroes and mentors to the Aeldari Aspect Warriors.

item.title: Codex: Aeldari masters combat with eight powerful Detachments to choose from
item.description: The article discusses the new Codex: Aeldari for Warhammer 40,000, highlighting its offering of eight diverse and powerful Detachments that enhance the strategic and combat capabilities of Aeldari armies.

item.title: Trench Grime on Krieg Artillery with Contrast paints | Warhammer 40,000
item.description: This Warhammer tutorial video demonstrates how to effectively use Contrast paints to achieve a realistic trench grime effect on Krieg artillery models in Warhammer 40,000.

item.title: How to use the Ynnari and Harlequins in the new Codex: Aeldari
item.description: The article provides strategies and insights on effectively utilizing the Ynnari and Harlequins factions within the new Codex: Aeldari, highlighting key units, abilities, and synergies to enhance gameplay in Warhammer 40K.
